description:
Tier 4 of T-054's layered update-notification design (tiers 1–3 — cached version-check.ts, SessionStart notice on `zug pull`/`zug resume`, and a generic CLI stderr notifier — are done). Deferred because it needs the T-045 SQLite control plane.

Scope:
1. `/sync/pull` response gains a `latestVersion` field (server already knows the published npm version, or reads it from the same registry check client-side code uses). The CLI/model can surface it — a second channel beyond the client-side npm registry check, for synced users who hit the canonical server every session.
2. Optional server-enforced minimum-version floor: for security-critical releases, the server can reject sync requests from clients below a configured minimum version (distinct from the notify-only default — T-054's hard constraint against silent auto-update still holds; this is "refuse to sync," not "auto-update").

Acceptance: a synced user's pull response includes latestVersion; a client below an enforced security floor gets a clear rejection (not a silent failure) telling them to run `zug update`; the default path remains notify-only per T-054.

Relation: sibling to T-054 (client-side tiers 1–3, already shipped); depends on T-045's durable control plane for storing/configuring the min-version floor.
title: Server-driven update advertising + security min-version floor (synced users)
